<div style="font-size:115%; margin-bottom:1em;">
'''Research Assessment Wiki''' collects, for every research topic, ''what is worth looking at'' when
researchers in that topic are evaluated: the leading journals and conferences, the relevant awards,
other important contributions, and a suggested weighting of these. The criteria are drafted
automatically from open data and then reviewed and refined by experts of each field.
</div>

''Pilot phase: the pages currently contain only the topic classification. Criteria have not yet been
reviewed by experts.''

== Why ==
Fields publish and evaluate differently. In computer science the top conferences matter as much as
journals; in mathematics author order is alphabetical; in particle physics a paper can have a thousand
authors. A single, field-independent number cannot capture this. Following the principles of
[https://coara.eu CoARA] and [https://sfdora.org DORA], this wiki makes the field-specific criteria
explicit, open and open to debate.

== How it is organised ==
* '''Classification:''' the ~4,500 topics of [https://openalex.org OpenAlex], grouped into
  4 domains → 26 fields → 252 subfields → topics. Start at the '''[[OpenAlex topic hierarchy]]'''.
* '''Inheritance:''' general criteria (awards, weights) are set at subfield level; a topic page only
  records what differs, together with its own list of venues.
* '''Venue levels:''' journals and conferences will be placed on a level scale, starting from
  established national lists (the Finnish [https://julkaisufoorumi.fi Publication Forum] and the
  [https://kanalregister.hkdir.no Norwegian Register]) and international conference rankings.
* '''Structured data:''' every page is built from templates whose fields are stored in a database,
  so the criteria can later be queried and turned into metrics.

== How to contribute ==
* Read the page of your topic or subfield and use its '''discussion''' tab to propose changes,
  with a short justification.
* Invited experts receive an account and can edit directly. Changes become visible after a
  curator of the subfield approves them.
* Disagreement is welcome: where experts disagree, the page shows the range of views rather than
  forcing a single answer.

== Magyarul röviden ==
Az oldal minden OpenAlex-témakörre összegyűjti, mit érdemes figyelembe venni az adott terület
kutatóinak értékelésénél: a meghatározó folyóiratokat és konferenciákat, a díjakat, az egyéb
fontos hozzájárulásokat és ezek javasolt súlyozását. A vázlatok nyílt adatokból, automatikusan
készülnek, és a terület szakértői véleményezik és pontosítják őket.
